'''MrPerfect I Play Sabaac While I Hunt''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[MrPerfect]]
* '''Published:''' 21 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD MrPerfect DS 2002 IPlaySab.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Vader rapes and pillages while Lando gets his game on.

== Strategy ==

Immediately look for and deploy Lando, only if you managed to get either Lobot, A Real Hero, or Unexpected Interruption in your hand though. The last thing you need is for your Lando to be converted. It's not likley, but just a precaution. The game depends on him, somewhat. Alright, start hunting. Eventually, you want to get Lando with some protection at the casino and hopefully sabaac every turn. With the deck being made the way it is, you should win about 90% of the time. That means you recover 3 force. Isn't it sweet? Now, most people duel right away when they can. I like to drop Vader and Tarkin on Luke or Obi, hopefully there will be someone else with them, and start a battle. Then play either Circle of Obsession. This way, if you win the duel, they are either on your side by the battle resolution phase, or out of the game entirely. Either way its a sweet deal for you. Feel free to drain everywhere you can, but don't spread yourself to thin. Enjoy, and remember, keep a Sabaac face on.
